instruction: find the mug and stop in front of it
notes: The reference task: a mug on the floor of the room, 1.5 m ahead and 1.2 m to the left of the start. The room's own safety notes (walls, the table, the doorway) are added by --scene room. Sim: g1 task run tasks/find_the_mug --env sim --headless (or mjpython -m g1 task run ... to watch). Robot: put a mug on the floor and run g1 task run tasks/find_the_mug --env robot --iface <iface> --mode standing --camera-ip <ip> --walk.
